jcr:content.shortDescription: A playground stop and a woodland adventure in one spacious Bristol estate.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Blaise combines open lawns, woodland walks and play areas for younger and older children. The castle on the hill gives a walk a destination, while the grounds work just as well for a relaxed picnic.

Our family idea: begin with the play area, then follow a short woodland route before lunch. On a museum opening day, combine your walk with a look at everyday objects from the past in Blaise Museum.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Mixed-age families who want playtime and a walk.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play areas, cafe, picnic areas and toilets with baby changing.
placepracticalinfo.parking: The main car park is off Kings Weston Road; check current charges and closing times.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Woodland and gorge routes can be steep. The castle and museum have their own opening arrangements.

placevisitmap.travelNote: The main car park is off Kings Weston Road; check current charges and closing times. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
